title: Valuative separatedness with locally Noetherian source
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $X$ locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Then $f$ is separated, meaning that its diagonal $X\to X\times_SX$ is a closed immersion [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-closed-immersion], if and only if the following uniqueness condition holds: for every valuation ring $V$ with fraction field $L$, every morphism $b:\operatorname{Spec}V\to S$, and every pair of morphisms $u,v:\operatorname{Spec}V\to X$ over $b$, equality $u|_{\operatorname{Spec}L}=v|_{\operatorname{Spec}L}$ implies $u=v$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Here a valuation ring is an integral domain $V$ such that each nonzero element $x$ of $L$ satisfies $x\in V$ or $x^{-1}\in V$.

Uniqueness is exactly equality of two lifts over each valuation square; the two directions are IsSeparated.valuativeCriterion (:274) and IsSeparated.of_valuativeCriterion (:246). No quasi-compactness of X or f and no finiteness of S is assumed.
